comment: The quick-add button makes capturing an idea feel effortless.
The board loads slowly when a workspace has many cards.
A compact tag picker would make organizing notes easier.
The reminder preview disappeared once after changing time zones.
Dragging a card between columns is clear and predictable.
Search is useful, but results take a moment to appear.
I would like a shared calendar color palette for teams.
One archived card returned to the active board after a refresh.
The keyboard shortcuts are easy to discover and remember.
The monthly view is smooth, but the agenda view is slower.
A board template gallery would help new teams get started.
The week view gives me exactly the right amount of context.
